reconcile.note: Gill reads Melchizedek's 'without father, without mother' as simply unrecorded ancestry, not a denial that he too descended from Adam through natural parents.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells pairs Genesis 3:20's claim that Eve is the mother of all living with Hebrews 7:3's description of Melchizedek as having no father, no mother, and no genealogy to argue the Bible undercuts its own claim of universal descent from Adam.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: The man called his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all living.
sides.verseText: The man called his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all living.
